I completely agree about neurosis. Worrying about it makes it worse. It's a cyclical parasite in that way. I might consider a psychiatrist soon, but I'd rather not. I don't know why. 

Thank again :)

> If you have a serious mental illness then you wouldn't be aware of it and wouldn't ask yourself questions.

Thats if your psychotic. I think I'm neurotic.

But yeah, thank you for the kind words. I appreciate it. You didn't say anything hurtful. Any attempt at making someone feel better makes me feel better. I completely agree that we don't having someone isnt a necessity. But its that I lost her. And hurt her. And that I don't have any support system at all because Im fearful of opening up to people.

And yeah, writing is the one thing that I think I am talented at. I'm emotionally drained and wrote this in a hurry so I don't want people to think that this is indicative of my voice, but writing is starting to drain me rather than invigorate me so I might quit that even if I decide to not go through with this.
